The San and Ju|’hoan people of Namibia use beetle

The oldest direct evidence of the use of poisoned

The archaeological levels in which these poisoned arrows were

questions.evidence: Surprisingly, poison assisted-hunting is widely known from a variety of archaeological and ethnographic contexts.
